essence: Drawing in the fish coincides with being furnished with the net of power
Bound beings are commonly defined by their lack of knowledge
The brahmin leader took on the role of a fisherman
The families gave rise to what belongs to the unmanifest sphere
Vighneśa and Nandin stand in a comparison involving Mahākāla and the wise recipient
